GET /api/today now attaches a required `locationContexts` array keyed by event id, derived from existing cycle-73 geocode_cache rows — Today never calls mapGateway.geocodeAddress, makes no provider HTTP/geocode POST, writes no cache row, and does no bulk/auto geocoding. Shared: TodayLocationStatus enum (missing|uncached|resolved|ambiguous|zero_results|failed), TodayEventLocationContextSchema (.strict, reuses GeocodeConfidence/Uncertainty from maps.js), TodaySurfaceSchema gains required locationContexts. Backend: read-only repo findGeocodeByNormalizedSet (drizzle inArray, empty→[]); pure services/today-location-context.ts buildTodayLocationContexts (dedup events by id, deterministic provider-asc cache pick, normalizeLocation; blank→missing, no-row→uncached, row→cached status with uncertainty JSON.parse→GeocodeUncertaintySchema.safeParse→null fail-open); buildTodaySurface gains locationContexts as its last param (returned additively, card discriminants/order/priority/feasibility unchanged); routes/today.ts collects dayEvents∪needsReviewEvents∪unscheduledEvents (post domain-filter), reads cache once, builds + passes contexts. Frontend: TodayLocationChip rendered as a SIBLING of each card title button (never nested) on next_event, needs_review, schedule_prompt, and BOTH conflict pair events: resolved→displayLabel∥locationText + confidence chip + coordinate map link; ambiguous→authored + 확인 필요 + authored-text link; zero_results/failed→authored + quiet 찾지 못함 + authored-text link; uncached→authored + quiet 확인 안 함 with NO link (a link would imply unearned recognition); missing→nothing. mapHrefForContext builds a public https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=… URL with only encoded coords (resolved, non-null lat/lng) or authored text — target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer; no API key, provider URL, raw payload, error_message, or SDK; providerStatus/providerResultId never surfaced. styles.css .today-loc* semantic tokens, 44px map link. All existing card actions (next_event detail, needs_review reply, schedule_prompt slot/dismiss, conflict sheet open) preserved. No migration, gateway/config, geocoding route/service, travel-time, or feasibility change. Tests: shared +3 (context statuses + strict + surface field), builder unit +6, today route integration +4 (resolved+uncached+no-write, missing, malformed-uncertainty fail-open, no-gateway), frontend +5.
